reason:
Value/transfer lens. The realistic public gain is about +0.0003, far below the +0.002 bar, and a probe cannot tell it apart from LB noise of 0.003.
(1) Linefit ceiling, recomputed. Linefit only moves node positions: topology and node count stay the same (x138 cell 5, linefit_smooth_output_graph). So it acts only through the 7 um matching. Its whole +0.0145 on the 12 LOEO-44b6 videos is about 72 edge events (+31 TP, -41 FP) out of ~4,363 GT edges (experiments/local_friend_b_exp02_public_port/results/exp29__linefit_*.json). The B28 grid points differ by only 23-26 events. A quadratic through w0.5 0.8948 / w0.8 0.9001 / w1.0 0.8955 puts the grid-coordinate optimum at w*~0.76, with curvature ~0.08 per unit^2. I ran a smoother MSE simulation (velocity random walk + i.i.d. localisation noise, the same 5-point symmetric fit, calibrated to w*=0.75). A 7/13/20% drop in per-node random noise moves w* to 0.70/0.675/0.65 and recovers only 1.6/3.0/6.1% of linefit's own MSE gain. The real score curve is ~3.3x sharper than the MSE model (B28 loses 37%/32% of linefit's gain at w0.5/w1.0; the model says 10%/12%). Even allowing for that, the in-sample lab gain is +0.0005..+0.0012. How much the noise actually drops is uncertain. The public head cuts GT distance 1.73->1.60 um on the 6bba-heavy folds, but about half of that is a constant z offset (+0.73->+0.35 um), and a constant offset cancels in a temporal smoother. On 44b6 it is 1.50->1.30 um (experiments/coordhead_retrain/out_full_P/report.txt). The window stays at 2: win1 cost -0.0094 (47 events), and a 20% noise drop cannot recover that.
(2) Gates and readmit are worth ~0. A 6-7 um flow gate sits 4-5 sigma beyond a 1.8 um median step, so a 10-20% noise change barely moves the tail. Pairs that miss the tight gate fall to the relaxed 10 um pass anyway. The swap/diverted/taken FN are localisation misses: the motion model prefers our link in 98.6% of swaps (sibling verdict v_linking-on-x138_x138-tail-lab-headcoords_value.json). Tightening a gate cannot create the correct link. It can only turn an FP into no edge, at 6.6e-6 per edge. On LB the whole stages scored ~0 on the grid base: flow2 0.947 -> +gapfill 0.947 -> +readmit 0.946. 'Relink knobs' is a CLOSED line in BRIEF. Readmit and gapfill candidates come from the low-detection dump as UNREFINED int16 peaks (DIFF.md sec.2 cell 4 (3)), so the 'refined coordinates' premise does not apply to them. The readmit radius also changes the node count, which adds a node-multiplier artefact (+1% nodes = -0.0009).
(3) Transfer. The lab detector and edge net are in-sample on all 199 videos, and the head is in-sample on ~20 of them. Lab positions are therefore cleaner than on test, and the lab favours exactly the proposed direction: less smoothing, tighter gates. On the unseen private embryos noise is higher, so the optimum sits at or above 0.8 and the change can reverse. Position-only lab gains have transferred poorly: float output lab +0.0018 -> LB tie; division insertion +0.0019 -> +0.001; relink-off +0.0053 -> -0.002. With a 0.5x-0 discount, a lab gain of +0.0005..+0.0012 becomes ~+0.0003 on public. The adoption rule 'LB >= base + 0.001' fires under pure noise with P~0.37 (sd of a difference ~0.003).
(4) The protocol cancels itself. The grid is {0.5, 0.65, 0.8} x FLOW {6.0, 6.5, 7.0} x READMIT {3, 4} x win {1, 2}, and the rule is 'shade one step toward the x138 default'. If the plausible winner (w0.65, FLOW 6.5, R3, win1) wins, shading returns it to the default, and nothing ships unless an implausible extreme wins.
(5) The pre-registered gate (>= +0.002 on confirmation) is above what the mechanism can deliver even in-sample, so the lab is set up to fail its own gate. Its cost is the scarce friend A (x138 199-video cache) plus a probe slot.
fix_if_any: Do not run a tail grid or a solo LB probe. Zero-cost salvage: (a) If friend A builds an x138 head-coordinate lab cache for a higher-value purpose (DaughterNet insertion on x138, detector retrain validation), add ONE pre-registered linefit-only variant, w=0.7 at window 2. Test it on 6bba odd for selection and on 6bba even + 44b6 for confirmation. Require both embryos >= 0 and >= 55% of videos positive per embryo. Do not shade. Drop the flow gate, readmit radius and window variants: they are bounded at ~0 by the LB stage history and the unrefined readmit peaks. (b) If it passes, ship it only inside a bundle (e.g. with the #35 insertion) or as the F2 hedge. Never probe it alone, because its effect (~+0.0003 public) is below LB resolution. (c) A better-founded version of the same idea is a per-node adaptive linefit weight driven by the head's own confidence: shrink toward the fit less when the head shift is large. That needs an out-of-fold head, so it is not reachable by 29 Sep.
realistic_public_gain: +0.0003 (range -0.001..+0.001); P(>= +0.002) ~0.03; P(>= +0.001) ~0.15. Linefit reweighting accounts for almost all of it; gates and readmit add ~0.
realistic_private_gain: ~0 (range -0.001..+0.0008). Unseen embryos have higher localisation noise than the in-sample lab, so the optimal weight sits at or above 0.8. Less smoothing and tighter gates are the directions most likely to reverse on private.
